screen: /start, step 4 Review and start, 390 px, full
title: At 390 px a file name or issuer name with no spaces widens the whole review sheet, clipping every Edit button, the file name and the Submit button.
expected: D-32 and D-42: long text wraps and content reflows without loss; the Documents step already wraps the same file name (StartRun.tsx:628, wrap-anywhere).
actual: With the 58-character file name Northbridge_Group_Annual_Report_and_Accounts_2025_Final.txt the review column grows and the five Edit buttons end at x=502 in a 390 px window (the Submit button spans 37 to 518); the page has no horizontal scroll (page overflow 0), so the buttons are cut off. A 200-character name made the column 3,237 px wide. At 600, 820 and 1100 px nothing is clipped.
suggested_change: Add min-w-0 and wrap-anywhere to the review Facts dd, the List and passive-item li, and the Block container, as the Documents list already does.

title: Moving between steps adds no browser history entry, so Back, Reload or the Library link silently discards every document, answer and approval typed so far.
expected: A four-step form whose completed steps are buttons (CM-083) keeps the analyst's work when the browser's own Back or Reload is used, or warns before it is lost (D-35: no pointer-only path; D-31: no silent lost state).
actual: At step 3 the history holds 3 entries and the URL stays /start; Back left for /runs, Forward returned a form with the template issuer name and 0 documents; Reload cleared the analyst name and the document list. No beforeunload dialog was raised in any case. The draft stays on the server (see C2-008).
suggested_change: Push a history entry per step (state kept in memory for the page's life) or raise a beforeunload warning once a document or answer exists.

title: Start from an earlier run says it copies the earlier answers but drops which documents are the agreement and the portfolio workbook, so the review opens with 'Will refuse: Legal & covenants'.
expected: CT-006 and the page's own sentence 'Review the copied answers': answers carried from the earlier run (attachments.legal_documents, portfolio_workbook) are applied to the form.
actual: The earlier run's inputs hold attachments legal_documents=executed and portfolio_workbook=true, yet the Context step opens with Legal documents 'No agreement' and Portfolio workbook 'None'; the review sheet then lists 'Will refuse' for Legal & covenants and a Check on the unchosen workbook, which the analyst must re-enter.
suggested_change: Seed legal and attachments from prior.context.attachments (legal_documents at least) when a run is carried, or say on the page that the document roles must be chosen again.

title: When the run options cannot be loaded the page shows the raw service text in a plain box with no action beneath an intro that still invites the analyst to start, and loading is a text line.
expected: D-31: loading is a static skeleton; an error is the alert with tone and an action, never a raw error string.
actual: A 500 with {error:'boom: internal'} draws exactly 'boom: internal' in a bordered box under 'Choose the documents and purpose, then review what will run.'; a refused connection draws 'Failed to fetch'; there is no Reload or Retry control. While loading, the page shows the sentence 'Loading run options…' (role=status), not a skeleton.
suggested_change: Draw the kit alert with a Reload action and a skeleton while loading; replace the raw text with a fixed sentence and keep the intro only on success.

title: Pressing Carry over from latest run leaves keyboard focus on the page body and announces nothing, because the button is replaced by 'This is a different issuer'.
expected: D-35, D-38 and D-43: after an action replaces the focused control, focus goes somewhere sensible and the result is announced.
actual: After Enter on 'Carry over from latest run' (issuer with an earlier run) document.activeElement is body; the intro 'Starting from run …' is a plain paragraph, so no live region speaks it (status regions read ['']). The restore effect only refocuses when the control's text is unchanged, and the busy fieldset has already dropped focus. Pressing 'This is a different issuer' keeps focus (same node reused).
suggested_change: After the carry, focus the new button or the 'Starting from run' paragraph and give that paragraph role=status.

screen: /start, step 4 Review and start and step 1 Documents, error
title: A failed Submit or a refused request reaches the analyst as the browser's raw 'Failed to fetch' or a lowercase service fragment run into the next sentence.
expected: D-31: no raw error string; a sentence per failure. A failed Submit is the paid step, so what happened and whether a run started must be plain.
actual: Network failure on Submit reads 'Failed to fetch Retrying Submit run is safe.'; a refused Submit reads 'documents or answers changed after approval Review the run again before submitting.' and 'unknown submission Review the run again before submitting.' (no full stop, lower case); the same 'Failed to fetch' appears when the draft cannot be created or the options cannot load.
suggested_change: Map fetch failures to one fixed sentence ('The service could not be reached') and join the retry sentence with proper punctuation and capitalisation.

title: The decisions that block Submit sit at the bottom of the review sheet, after about 2,700 px (3,600 px at 390 px) of echoed inputs and 20 'Not given' rows.
expected: D-17: a limit is a decision, not a scrolled-past line; D-22: one clear first thing per screen; D-03: unlike content looks different.
actual: Nine grey input blocks of one design (16 labelled groups) come first; 'Limits to decide' starts 2,694 px below the heading at 1440 px and 3,602 px at 390 px (viewport 900 and 844). Until then only the side panel (hidden under the form on narrow windows) or the one-line blocker tells the analyst that 4 decisions remain and Submit is disabled.
suggested_change: Draw 'Limits to decide' directly under the heading and fold blocks that only say 'Not given' into one line or a closed disclosure.

title: The page leaves a server-side draft behind whenever the form is abandoned, and after 50 drafts every new form fails with 'too many unfinished submissions; try again later' for up to 24 hours.
expected: A start page that creates a draft reuses or removes it, and a refusal states how to recover (D-31).
actual: Three forms abandoned after Continue added 3 drafts (6 to 9). With 50 open drafts the next Continue draws the alert 'too many unfinished submissions; try again later' (lower case), the form cannot proceed, and no control clears the drafts; the service sweeps them only after STALE_SECONDS = 24 hours.
suggested_change: Delete the draft on page hide, or reuse the newest open draft for the same browser session, and say 'try again after 24 hours' in the refusal.

title: Run form level offers Standard, which behaves exactly like Basic.
expected: CT-005: the run form level is Basic or Advanced; a choice should change something the analyst can see.
actual: Standard shows the same 24 controls as Basic on the Context step (identical lists) and only the word 'Standard' travels to the summary and the review; the help text explains Advanced only.
suggested_change: Remove Standard from the select, or state what it adds.

title: Leave out and Put back on the review sheet discard the review and its approval and return to More context without saying so.
expected: A control inside the sheet changes the sheet; if it leaves the sheet it says so.
actual: 'Leave out Legal & covenants' and 'Put back' both land on the More context heading, the review is gone, 'Review run' must be pressed again and the approval is cleared. Neither button's text or the sentence under it mentions this.
suggested_change: Keep the sheet and recompute it in place, or add 'You will review again' under the buttons.

title: Document refusals change the case of a file name and quote raw parser text.
expected: Source identities are shown exactly (AGENTS.md: preserve source identities); D-31: plain wording.
actual: empty.txt is shown as 'Empty.txt has no extractable text (scanned image?)' (the launcher-line capitaliser changes the name); notes.docx gives 'Cannot read notes.docx: File is not a zip file'; image.png gives 'The uploaded documents: no readable issuer file'. One unreadable file blocks the whole reading, and every row keeps the grey 'Selected' badge.
suggested_change: Do not capitalise the first character when it starts a file name; mark the refused row 'Ignored' with the reason beside it.

title: The 50 MB limit in the drop-zone hint is not checked when a file is chosen; a 52 MB file is uploaded in full and refused with a message that names no file.
expected: The drop zone supports maxSize and onSizeLimitExceed (file-upload-base.tsx:30-36,110-126); a stated limit is checked at selection.
actual: big52.txt (52 MB) is listed as 'Selected'; Inspect sends the whole file and the service answers 400 'a file is at most 50 MB', shown at the top of the card with no file name and a console error.
suggested_change: Pass maxSize (50 * 1024 * 1024) and an onSizeLimitExceed handler that names the file.

title: Choosing the same file or folder twice lists it twice, and the problem is reported only at Continue without naming the row.
expected: Duplicate selections are caught when added, or the refused row is marked.
actual: Choosing a folder twice (or two files with the same name) lists both rows; Inspect or Continue then draws 'Choose documents with distinct file names.' while every row still says 'Selected'.
suggested_change: Skip a file already in the list (same name, size and modified time) and mark duplicates by name.

title: The Issuer ID rule is never stated, the derived ID drops letters such as Ø and is empty for non-Latin names, and only the browser's native bubble reports it.
expected: CT-002: pattern [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}; the analyst is told the rule before the browser refuses.
actual: 'Ørsted A/S' becomes 'rsted-a-s'; 'Эрикссон' and '日本電信電話' give an empty required field; 'Northbridge Group' typed into the ID gives only 'Please match the requested format.' The page's own sentence 'Enter an issuer name and an issuer ID using letters a–z, digits or hyphens' is reachable only for a name of spaces (native required/pattern block first).
suggested_change: Add help text under Issuer ID with the rule and transliterate Ø, ß and similar before dropping characters.

title: Your name is required but not marked, and its rule is checked only at Review run, after three steps.
expected: CT-009: required; the rule shown with the field (it is, as help text) and the field marked required before the analyst moves on.
actual: The field has no required or aria-required; 'bad' passes Documents, Purpose and Context and only the Review run press returns the analyst to Documents with the alert (focus lands on the field and the 1-problem button works).
suggested_change: Check the name when leaving Documents and mark the field required.

title: Stepper notes, field help, pathway module counts, document badges and the drop-zone hint are set at 12 px.
expected: D-30: nothing written here set below 13 px.
actual: Computed font size 12 px on 'Add files', 'Choose one', 'Optional', 'Paid step', '5 base modules' and the other seven chips, 'Selected', 'Three uppercase letters.', 'Your short label…' and the 'Add filings and other source documents' hint (4 to 39 elements per screen).
suggested_change: Raise these to the 13 px caption size.

title: All eight pathway cards carry the same file-check icon, which says nothing about the pathway.
expected: D-20 (no decorative icons that carry no meaning) and D-03 (do not reuse one design for unlike items).
actual: Every card header draws FileCheck02 in the same brand tile; the cards differ only by title, one sentence and the module count.
suggested_change: Drop the icon or use one that names the pathway's purpose.

title: 'I accept these 6 limits' counts every affected module, while the card shows one limit and an 'Also affects' list.
expected: The wording matches what the analyst can see; the page's own counters say '0 of 4 decided'.
actual: One 'Will refuse' card (Legal & covenants) lists five more modules under 'Also affects'; its checkbox reads 'I accept these 6 limits', and the readiness counter counts it as one of 4 decisions.
suggested_change: Word it 'I accept this limit and its 5 consequences'.

title: 'Add facility', 'Add quote', 'Add rating' and the other Add buttons disable at their maximum with no reason.
expected: D-31: a disabled control says why.
actual: Add facility stops after 20 rows; the button is disabled with no sentence about the maximum.
suggested_change: Show 'Most 20 facilities' beside the disabled button.

title: With documents waiting to be carried the list says 'No documents yet.' while Continue and Inspect are enabled.
expected: The list or a sentence names what will be copied.
actual: The earlier run's three documents appear only after Inspect or Continue; before that the card reads 'No documents yet.'
suggested_change: Show the carried file names (from prior.files) as 'Will be copied' rows.

title: An unknown or malformed from= run shows the service's raw words 'unknown run' or 'not found' in a quiet status line.
expected: D-31: no raw error string; say the earlier run could not be found and that this is a new form.
actual: ?from=does-not-exist shows 'unknown run', ?from=../../etc/passwd shows 'not found', both as muted role=status text; the form opens blank.
suggested_change: Replace with 'The earlier run could not be found. Starting a new form.'

title: Choosing a different pathway silently clears the Requested modules selection.
expected: The analyst is told when a choice already made is reset.
actual: Unchecking one of 20 modules under Deep, then choosing Full on Purpose leaves all 14 checked with no message.
suggested_change: Say 'Module choice reset for the new pathway' (role=status).

title: A service sentence reads 'This pathway does not produce the What changed since the last Report report section.' and the same part of the report has two names on the sheet.
expected: Reader-facing wording is plain and one name per thing (D-16).
actual: 'No action needed (1)' shows the sentence above, 'Report sections omitted · What changed since the last Report' is drawn under Purpose and modules, while the module list of a run with an earlier run names the same part 'Changes since the last run'.
suggested_change: Write 'This pathway does not produce the "What changed since the last Report" section.' or use one name.

title: A Submit answered 200 without a run id navigates to /run/undefined.
expected: A reply without a run id is an error shown on the review, not a navigation.
actual: With the submit reply {status:'queued'} the page navigated to /run/undefined (the Run page then said 'unknown run' and called /connected/activity/undefined, 404).
suggested_change: Check typeof id === 'string' and a non-empty id before navigating.

title: The analyst-name help says the name is 'Shown on Run activity and in Teams', which no matrix row accounts for and which is not true in a synthetic or unconfigured service.
expected: CM-091 and CT-042: Teams cards are a service setting, not something the interface promises.
actual: Help text under Your name: '… Shown on Run activity and in Teams.' Teams posting happens only when CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_WEBHOOK and CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_LINK are set; a synthetic service never posts.
suggested_change: none

title: IntakeView carries capText and synthetic, which no step component reads.
expected: Props that are passed are used.
actual: Neither view.capText nor view.synthetic is read anywhere; capText and synthetic reach the panels as their own props.
suggested_change: Delete the two members and their assignments.

title: Two fail-open notes mislead: console.warn says a launcher flag is 'not shown' when its text is shown, and the FieldProblem for a blank issuer name is reachable only for whitespace.
expected: Warnings say what happened; branches are reachable.
actual: For '--sources: empty.txt has no extractable text' the page shows the message (capitalised) yet logs 'Launcher flag not shown to the analyst'. The required and pattern attributes on Issuer name and Issuer ID stop an empty or invalid value before reviewDetails runs.
suggested_change: Reword the warning; decide whether native or custom validation owns the issuer fields.

title: Stage 0's inventory of /start omits the controls revealed by Valuation basis, Peer source, scenario pins, Listed equity, Leave out/Put back and the Previous button on the Purpose and Context steps.
expected: Every control is in the inventory (brief, step 1).
actual: Missing: Previous (Purpose, Context), Ticker, Add peer, Add precedent and their row fields (Name, Ticker, EV (m), EBITDA (m), As-of, Source, Target, Acquirer, Date) and Remove Peer 1 and Remove Precedent 1, Market cap (m), Net debt (m), Enterprise value (m), EBITDA basis, Market data as-of, Market data source, Multiple (x), Multiple basis, Rationale (six), EBITDA decline (%), Interest increase (%), Add scenario, Remove Scenario 1, Horizon (months), Minimum cash (m), Rate shocks (bps), FX shocks (%), Hedge ratio (%), Repricing (bps), Recovery (%), EV multiple, Put back. About 45 controls; all were operated and wired correctly (p16, p24).
suggested_change: Add these states to the stage 0 inventory script.
